commitResults.messageTitle: Add client storage and note validation
commitResults.messageBody:
The project model exposes a client lookup but has no client collection.
Add clients with sequential IDs and ordered notes, and implement the
existing lookup so projects can validate registered clients.

Cover blank values, note ownership, immutable snapshots, ID allocation
and the real project lookup with JUnit tests.

Allow users to register clients from the CLI with generated IDs and
confirmation messages. Reject missing, blank and repeated names without
consuming IDs, and show the expected syntax after invalid input.

Add shared client routing and connect the real client lookup to project
creation. Keep these changes isolated from the project command handlers.
Include tests for registration, validation and project integration.

Append notes to an existing client using its positional ID and text/
argument. Preserve earlier notes and report missing clients or invalid
note arguments without changing stored data.

Recognize command-specific prefixes without reserving text/ in project
names. Test note ownership, validation, recovery and parser compatibility.

Display a client's ID, name and all notes in insertion order. Show an
explicit empty-notes message when no notes have been recorded.

Require exactly one existing client ID and show a usage hint after
invalid input. Test viewing, ID validation and whitespace preservation.

List client IDs and names in creation order with numbered entries.
Display an empty-list message and follow the guide's rule to ignore
extra arguments for commands that take no parameters.

Test populated and empty lists, and add the complete CLI workflow test
covering all four client commands, error recovery and project creation.

Record the four client command formats, validation rules and integration
contract so teammates can use the shared client manager consistently.

Add fixed console inputs and complete expected output with a repeatable
runner and captured test session. Compare the packaged CLI without
normalizing anything except line endings, using the test-ui workflow.

Verify 330 JUnit tests, both Checkstyle checks and one console acceptance
case with Java 25.
Implement client management commands
Update AboutUs in tutorial
